ns2:section.sectionText: This course presents an overview of classical control design tools and methods and bridges those with state-space approach. Topics include root locus, Bode diagrams, Nyquist criteria, robustness margins, lead-lag compensators, observability and controllability, internal stability and input-output stability, pole-placement, observers and reduced order obervers, separation principle, performance limitations, linear quadratic regulator, optimal estimation and output feedback.
